title: Will there be opportunities to attend satsang or ask questions directly to Parikshit Bhaiya and mentors?

segments.text: Yes, absolutely! Parikshit Bhaiya will lead the main satsangs during the day, where he will meet visitors individually, scan auras, and share deep spiritual wisdom. ​Additionally, your mentors will be staying directly at Ashaeiynn alongside everyone else to serve and support you. You can reach out to them at any point throughout the day to ask questions, clarify doubts, or seek guidance—including during dedicated morning discussions and late-night practice sessions. We just ask that you remain mindful of their personal space and time so they can rest and recharge while serving the community.
